architecture: ViT-B/16 (12 layers, 12 heads, hidden 768, 197 patches, GAP+fc+softmax)

calibration.note: Grid search over T in [0.5,8.0] on the 175-image independent validation set minimised NLL at T=0.96 (NLL 0.34343 vs 0.34389 at T=1.0), i.e. no meaningful improvement over an unscaled softmax, and ECE was slightly better at T=1.0. T=1.0 is therefore retained. The previous model family used T=0.8278; reusing it here was measured to be WORSE (NLL 0.34962) and was rejected rather than carried over.

parity.int8_note: int8 post-training quantisation was built and REJECTED: 23/175 label agreement with the float model, 21/175 accuracy (12.0%), macro-F1 0.104, happy recall 0.000. The 171.9 MB fp16 artifact is shipped instead.

pendingValidation: on-device load time, latency, RSS and FPS unmeasured: no SM-M325F was reachable over adb when the model was selected
GPU (GpuDelegateV2) support for this graph unverified on Mali; CPU fallback is the guaranteed path
distribution packaging: 171.9 MB exceeds a comfortable base-APK budget and may require Play Asset Delivery

provenance.conversion: Hugging Face ViTForImageClassification -> exact Keras reimplementation (app-level graph port) -> tf.lite.TFLiteConverter float16_weights
provenance.note: onnx2tf's own float16 and SavedModel paths were both broken for this graph; the Keras reimplementation reproduces the PyTorch graph to 7.39e-06 max abs probability difference and is the conversion actually validated.
provenance.trainingDatasetVersion: UNDOCUMENTED - the upstream repository has no model card, so its FER training set is unknown and must not be assumed to match the independent validation set used here

testSet.note: Single stratified sample, 25 images per class, seed 42, from the public wallbreaker01/Facial-Expression-Detection test split. Balanced by construction, so the confusion matrix is per-class counts and accuracy is not skewed by class frequency. Small enough that per-class metrics carry roughly +/-0.07 sampling error.
